# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Inglis  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as neat, sensible, plain, and pink-cheeked.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Jane is placid, amiable, plain, plodding, and conscientious. She possesses steady nerves and is not easily rattled or troubled by high ambitions. Though not considered particularly brilliant, she is kind-hearted and careful never to say anything that would hurt anyone's feelings.

_Sources: [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Goals

- earn her salary fairly and please school trustees  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>
- get her name on the School Inspector's roll of honor  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea as part of Anne Shirley's close group of friends and attended Queen's Academy to study for a teaching certificate. After graduating, she taught school at Newbridge and served as a committee chairman for the Avonlea Voluntary Improvement Society. She later moved to the western prairies to teach in a school there. Eventually, she returned home and married Mr. Inglis, a Winnipeg millionaire, remaining friendly, unspoiled by wealth, and happily devoted to her old friends.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_
